title: A Leap into the Next Dimension of Vision
description:
2024 marks a leap into the next dimension of vision. 
This leap year, as Vision Pro transforms the Apple ecosystem, KWDC24 
will be the hub for sharing insights and growing together.
subtitle: It’s time for every vision to take flight.

2025.content:
We are weaving various threads together: code with code, design with people, ideas with technology.
Those who once worked in their own languages are now beginning to understand each other's rhythms and are starting to weave a single pattern together.

KWDC25 is a story of intertwining knowledge and experience. Technology meets tradition, and past weaving methods come alive like a modern network. Thoughts that once fluttered like flags in the wind are now intricately connected and flowing through the Apple ecosystem.

Developers, designers, and creators who have built unique experiences in their own domains are now at a point where they cross boundaries to create something together. We are no longer alone.

Here, in this modern workshop, weave, knit, share, and connect. In this place, we are intertwined, and through these connections, we are united.
